# AWS Global Accelerator
> AWS Global Accelerator is a networking service that improves application availability, performance, and failover using the AWS global network.

This site centers on the AWS Global Accelerator product within AWS documentation and related AWS resources, including service guides, API references, CLI commands, SDK usage, pricing, FAQs, and infrastructure-as-code references.

## Product Overview
- [AWS Global Accelerator Product Page](https://aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/): Overview of the service, benefits, use cases, and core networking capabilities.
- [What Is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html): Introduction to the service, concepts, and key features.
- [How AWS Global Accelerator Works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html): Explains traffic routing, anycast IPs, listeners, endpoint groups, and health checks.
- [AWS Global Accelerator FAQs](https://aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/faqs/): Answers to common questions about architecture, pricing, endpoints, and behavior.
- [AWS Global Accelerator Pricing](https://aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/pricing/): Pricing details for accelerators, data transfer, and optional features.

## Developer Guide
- [AWS Global Accelerator Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/): Main documentation hub for configuring and operating Global Accelerator.
- [Getting Started with AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/getting-started.html): Step-by-step guide to creating and testing an accelerator.
- [Listeners in AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-listeners.html): Describes listener ports, protocols, and traffic acceptance behavior.
- [Endpoint Groups in AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-endpoint-groups.html): Explains regional endpoint groups, traffic dials, and health settings.
- [Endpoints in AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-endpoints.html): Covers supported endpoint types and endpoint-specific behavior.
- [Health Checks and Endpoint Health](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoint-health.html): Details health check evaluation and endpoint availability handling.
- [Client Affinity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-listeners-client-affinity.html): Describes source IP affinity options and session routing behavior.

## Concepts and Architecture
- [Static IP Addresses and DNS Names](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-components.html): Describes accelerator components including static anycast IPs and DNS names.
- [Standard Accelerators](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-standard-accelerator.html): Explains the standard accelerator type and its routing model.
- [Custom Routing Accelerators](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-custom-routing-accelerator.html): Introduces custom routing accelerators and port-based endpoint mapping.
- [Supported Endpoints for Standard Accelerators](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints-caveats.html): Lists endpoint support, caveats, and service-specific considerations.
- [AWS Global Network and Routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html): Explains edge entry points and traffic flow across AWS infrastructure.

## Operations and Administration
- [Managing Accelerators](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-accelerators.html): Operational guidance for creating, updating, and deleting accelerators.
- [Tagging AWS Global Accelerator Resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/tagging-resources.html): Describes tagging support and resource organization practices.
- [Accessing AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/accessing-global-accelerator.html): Covers console, API, CLI, and endpoint access methods.
- [Identity and Access Management for AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/security_iam_service-with-iam.html): IAM integration, permissions, and policy considerations.
- [Logging and Monitoring in AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/logging-monitoring.html): Monitoring and observability guidance for service operations.
- [Compliance Validation for AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/compliance-validation.html): Compliance program information and audit-related references.
- [Resilience in AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/disaster-recovery-resiliency.html): Service resiliency and disaster recovery considerations.

## API and Command Reference
- [AWS Global Accelerator API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/api/): Full API reference for service operations and data types.
- [CreateAccelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/api/API_CreateAccelerator.html): API operation for creating a standard accelerator.
- [CreateListener](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/api/API_CreateListener.html): API operation for creating a listener on an accelerator.
- [CreateEndpointGroup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/api/API_CreateEndpointGroup.html): API operation for defining regional endpoint groups.
- [AddEndpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/api/API_AddEndpoints.html): API operation for attaching endpoints to an endpoint group.
- [DescribeAccelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/api/API_DescribeAccelerator.html): API operation for retrieving accelerator configuration details.
- [AWS CLI globalaccelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/globalaccelerator/): Command reference for managing Global Accelerator with the AWS CLI.

## SDKs and Developer Tools
- [AWS SDK for JavaScript v3 Global Accelerator Client](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSJavaScriptSDK/v3/latest/client/global-accelerator/): JavaScript client reference for Global Accelerator operations.
- [Boto3 GlobalAccelerator Client](https://boto3.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/services/globalaccelerator.html): Python SDK client reference and available service methods.
- [AWS SDK for Java 2.x](https://sdk.amazonaws.com/java/api/latest/software/amazon/awssdk/services/globalaccelerator/package-summary.html): Java SDK package reference for Global Accelerator.
- [AWS SDK for .NET Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkfornet/v3/apidocs/items/GlobalAccelerator/NGlobalAccelerator.html): .NET SDK namespace reference for service clients and models.
- [AWS Tools for PowerShell Global Accelerator Cmdlets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/powershell/latest/reference/items/GlobalAccelerator_cmdlets.html): PowerShell cmdlet reference for Global Accelerator administration.
- [AWS CloudFormation AWS::GlobalAccelerator::Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-globalaccelerator-accelerator.html): CloudFormation resource reference for defining accelerators.
- [AWS CDK Global Accelerator Construct Library](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/api/v2/docs/aws-cdk-lib.aws_globalaccelerator-readme.html): CDK constructs for provisioning Global Accelerator resources.

## Security and Networking
- [Security in AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/security.html): Overview of security responsibilities, controls, and best practices.
- [Data Protection in AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/data-protection.html): Information about encryption, data handling, and protection expectations.
- [Infrastructure Security in AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/infrastructure-security.html): Describes infrastructure-level protections and service security posture.
- [AWS Global Accelerator Endpoints and Quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/global_accelerator.html): Service endpoints, regions, and quotas in AWS General Reference.
- [AWS Global Accelerator with Shield Advanced](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-ddos.html): DDoS-related protections and integration considerations.

- [Multi-Region Application Failover with AWS Global Accelerator](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/networking-and-content-delivery/deploying-multi-region-applications-in-aws-using-aws-global-accelerator/): Architecture pattern for regional failover and high availability.
- [Improving TCP and UDP Application Availability](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/networking-and-content-delivery/category/networking-content-delivery/aws-global-accelerator/): Blog category page with implementation examples and service announcements.
- [Custom Routing Accelerator Use Cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-custom-routing-accelerator.html): Documentation for port-based routing scenarios and specialized architectures.
